about_the_game:
This small add-on for Caribbean Legend is made primarily for those who already own the game but would still like to support our team.

For almost a year and a half, the “Supporter Pack” remained exclusive to the owners of the most expensive pre-orders, contest winners, and our friends — nearly two hundred people without whom our beloved game would never have been released.

Purchase, and you will receive:

  • Streltsy Sash

  • Charles de Maure’s Family Dagger

  • Amulet of Endurance

  • Imperial Musket

  • Potion “Tsar Vodka”

  • Triple-Barreled Pistol “Golden Eagle”

  • Mirror Armor — the best medium armor in the game

  • Mercenary’s Hat — a fine example of soldierly wit. Breaks. Can be repaired.

  • A small quest for both story and sandbox modes.

  • Two Steam achievements.

Gameplay tips:

  • The dagger, amulet, and pistol can be found together in a single treasure hoard.

  • Alonso will gift you the other items and the alchemy recipes for them.

  • Speak with Alonso upon reaching level 4, 8, 12, and 16.
